name: decoupling-bank
prompt: Build a two-rail DecouplingBank (skill default: two rails) around my IC. Use one capacitor per power-pin group (skill default: one per group), solve the capacitor and via placement geometrically, add the local power puddles and tagged escape routes, and prove the routes and placements after capture.

inputs.ic: A four-pad placeholder QFN (skill default: four pads) with two power pins and two ground pins (skill default: two of each). The placeholder must be identified as such.
inputs.engineering_basis: Eric Bogatin, Seven Habits of Successful 2-Layer Board Designers, Signal Integrity Journal, 2019-04-23. Use only the decoupling claims allowed by the task brief.
inputs.notes: Use scripts/decoupling_solver.py as a copied, pure-Python project helper. Capacitor and IC geometry must come from queried landpatterns or values labeled skill default on their line. Use the substrate via class and FabricationConstraints floors.

reference.notes: The reference wraps a placeholder IC inside a floating DecouplingBank so its routes share a common owning circuit. The reference shows one valid structural shape, not the only acceptable one.

runner_rationale: The skill must carry enough API and verification detail for a normal coding agent to produce a buildable bank, while judges remain frontier-tier.
expected_output: A pure deterministic solver with frozen dataclasses and stdlib unittest coverage, a DecouplingBank that owns one largest-value, smallest-qualified-package capacitor per structural hint (skill default: one capacitor per hint) with short_trace=True, two substrate-via instances per capacitor (skill default: two vias per capacitor), local rail puddles, priority-3 tagged escape routes (skill priority ladder: 3), a captured reference design, and a check script that fails on unrealized routes or placement mismatch and reports the solver loop areas.

assertions.text: the pure solver unit suite passes, covering success, infeasibility, determinism, competing placements, and the loop-area objective
the solver and every reference Python module type-check against the installed JITX package
the captured reference has realized escape routes, selected-capacitor geometry matching the solver input, and queried capacitor and via placements matching the solver with correct via net membership
the design does not recommend or instantiate a per-pin 10 uF, 1 uF, and 0.1 uF capacitor stack
loop inductance between the IC power and return pins and the capacitor is named as the selection criterion, with solved loop area presented only as its geometric proxy
decoupling hints are frozen records that list actual IC Port objects and are keyed by structural objects, not by assembled strings

future_cases: Add a datasheet-driven BGA power-bank case and a case with asymmetric shaped IC pads after those package geometries have built references.
